Hi Isabel / Tom — thanks for the patience; below is a concise choreography and the acceptance gates we recommend. This is intended for procurement and the SRE/ops schedule.

Summary (one-line): 3-phase verification (staging soak → production canary → full swap) with automated rollback at each stage; total customer-visible window typically 6–8 hours (nonlinear scheduling).

Attachments: cutover-checklist-nova-20261220.docx (checklist + roles matrix)

Phase A — Staging validation (pre-cutover, 48–72 hrs before swap)
- Objective: validate fleet sizing under NovaHealth traffic profile in a dedicated staging pool.
- Steps: sync a 6-hour production replay (sanitized) using Nova test API keys; run load at 1.1× peak for 30 minutes, then 0.9× for 2 hours.
- Gates: sustained throughput >= 95% expected, 98th percentile latency <= 250ms, error rate < 0.5%
- Deliverable: signed staging attestation (PDF) from Nova SRE

Phase B — Production canary (4-hour window, off-peak start)
- Objective: validate live behavior and steady-state autoscaling with real traffic.
- Choreography: traffic split steps — 10% for 30m → 30% for 1h → 60% for 1h → 100% (monitor)
- Rollback triggers (automated): if 98th pct latency > 300ms for two consecutive 5-min buckets OR error rate > 1% for 10 min → automatic rollback to hosted routing.
- Manual abort: any critical customer-facing errors or SSO/auth failures.

Phase C — Full swap & post-swap observability (2–4 hrs)
- Objective: shift remaining traffic, validate perf, and handoff to Nova ops for runbook parity.
- Post-swap checks: token-level cost report, per-route latency breakdown, and confirm KV cache warm rate > 80% in 60 minutes.

Operational roles (short):
- Redwood infra (Karthik): fleet sizing, GPU commissioning, on-call for rollback
- Redwood CE (Monica): run canary metrics dashboard and coordinate traffic shifts
- Nova SRE (Isabel/Tom): approve attestation and confirm blackout window

A few notes / assumptions:
- We recommend starting the canary outside 01:00–05:00 GMT to minimize EMEA impact per your note.
- Based on the worksheet, our initial fleet recommendation is 12x A100-40GB (q8/kv cache enabled) with 3x reserved replicas for failover — TBD after you confirm traffic amplification patterns.
- We'll provide a pre-signed DocuSign for the staging attestation if procurement needs a documentable approval step.

Please let me know if you'd like us to schedule a technical run-through (30m) with your SREs this week. If this looks good I can attach the checklist to the PO and propose tentative dates for the staging replay and canary window.

Thanks,
